<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
resolve_seq_len(config: ModelConfig, seq_len: int | None = None) -> int
```

Part of [`evoxc_hf.program`](/api/evoxc-hf/program/)

Resolve (and validate) the static sequence length of a graph.

`None` means `DEFAULT_SEQ_LEN` capped by the config's positional
range — `min(config.max_position_embeddings, 32)` — which is the default
`evoxc_hf.forward_fn` / `evoxc_hf.build` / `evoxc_hf.predict`
use.

## Parameters

- `config` · `ModelConfig` — the static model config (`~evoxc_hf.config.ModelConfig`).

- `seq_len` · `int | None` — the requested sequence length, or `None` for the default.

## Returns

- `int` — the validated static sequence length.

## Raises

- `HFConfigError` — `seq_len` is not a positive integer, or it exceeds
  `config.max_position_embeddings` (there is no position beyond
  `max_position_embeddings - 1` — RoPE / the learned position table
  has nothing there).
